context: Per-request context builder currently only exposes `db` and `currentUser` to resolvers, so any resolver needing a User or Product by id queries the database directly.
explanation: Safe to merge. Adding request-scoped `userLoader` and `productLoader` DataLoader instances lets resolvers batch and dedupe lookups within a single request instead of firing one query per object — the standard fix for N+1 queries when many fields resolve the same entity type across a response.
